title: a16z Podcast: The Rise of the Digital 'Pill'

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The first thing that comes to mind when treating health problems is the need to take a pill (or other pharmaceutical) of some kind..
reader_summary.overview: The first thing that comes to mind when treating health problems is the need to take a pill (or other pharmaceutical) of some kind. But could a digital therapeutic -- a software-based intervention -- not only complement, but possibly even replace pills? In this episode of the a16z Podcast.

key_points.text: In this episode of the a16z Podcast.
